title: Why I left
text:
It breaks my heart to see all you could be but you are not. To see you holding to a past that was never there. To make the wrong choice day after day. To feel there is no space left for me with all the noise your self-made problems make. So I ran away.
Call it fear, call it selfishness, I call it self preservation. Because I could never truly be me if I had stayed.
And I thank god for giving me the strength lo leave, and I pray to keep the will to continue without looking back.
Great things have arrived, and many more are still to come
